name: product-coverflow
title: Product Coverflow
description: A product coverflow loops product-surface mockups through a 3D carousel: each card's transform derives from its shortest signed distance to the active index so the row wraps seamlessly — translateX for spread, rotateY for the flanks, translateZ/scale/opacity for depth falloff. Card faces are fixed-light showcase content on a dark stage; the accent palette is self-contained CSS variables to remap per brand. Reduced motion stops the auto-advance.
